description: A young woman under a powerful curse boards a train to get to a cure but the snakes growing inside her burst out and attack the other passengers.

description: The Antichrist (Chad Mathews) rises to power while his own wife is pregnant with a holy child.

description: When giant monsters attack cities on the East Coast, three soldiers pilot giant robots to stop the attacks.

title: Invasion of the Pod People
description: After a meteor shower, Samantha notices people acting oddly and looks for help from Billie and a detective.

title: Super Cyclone
description: A meteorologist and a petroleum engineer battle the elements to stop a superstorm from destroying the entire Eastern seaboard.

description: Aliens invade Earth and give humans a choice to immigrate to a new planet or be killed. When most of humanity gives in to the demands, the President of the United States and a rogue militia fight back to expose the aliens' true plans.

description: Realizing that an enormous earthquake will sink California in two days, scientists attempt to rupture a volcano to displace the earthquake's energy.

description:

An all-female commune in Utah is where the two groups of survivors reunite, but when someone winds up dead, the illusion of paradise is shattered.

description:

When Mack tries to have a real date with Addy, he finds himself in a nightmare that reminds him of a certain Bill Murray film with déjà vu vibes.

title: Evil Nanny
description: When their nanny begins neglecting her duties, the Tripps have no choice but to fire her. They then learn that the nanny has established residency in their home and will have to be legally evicted -- which could take months.

title: Z Nation
description:
S02 E01 — The Murphy
Everyone tries to escape the impending nuclear blast; Citizen Z battles thawed zombies and issues an air bounty for Murphy.

title: Clown
description: Teens fight for their lives when they become trapped in a fun house and stalked by a crazy killer clown.

title: Exorcism: The Possession of Gail Bowers
description: Three priests and a psychologist try to help a demonically possessed girl (Erica Roby).

title: Dragon Crusaders
description: Members of the Knights Templar must defeat a wizardly dragon to break a horrific curse.

title: 5-Headed Shark Attack
description: Shaped like a terrifying starfish, a shark that has five heads terrorizes the open ocean and invades the beaches of Puerto Rico.

title: Sinbad and the War of the Furies
description: On a treasure hunt gone wrong, modern-day adventurer Sinbad accidentally releases the Furies, three beautiful but terrible ancient beings powerful enough to threaten life on Earth.

title: Z Nation
description:
S01 E07 — Welcome to the Fu-Bar
Still reeling from the events, the survivors come across a gun show that makes the zombie apocalypse look tame.

title: King Arthur and the Knights of the Round Table
description: Following an epic battle, Merlin banishes Morgana, and her son, Mordred, to the ends of the universe. Vowing revenge, Morgana and her son return to Earth 1,500 years later, and they are hell-bent on destroying every descendant of King Arthur.

title: Z Nation
description:
S01 E01 — Puppies and Kittens
In Upstate New York, a zombie baby proves to be an obstacle for a diverse group of survivors, as they head cross-country in hope of creating a cure for the living-dead condition.

title: Intermedio
description: Four unlucky friends encounter deadly creatures in tunnels on the Mexican border.

title: Apocalypse Pompeii
description: A former Special Ops commando enlists his old teammates for a mission to rescue his wife and daughter, who have become trapped by the eruption of Mount Vesuvius.

title: Halloween Night
description: A horribly burned man (Scot Nery) escapes from a mental institution and terrorizes teenagers at a party.

title: Pirates of Treasure Island
description: Lowly innkeeper Jim Hawkins (Tom Nagel) and Long John Silver (Lance Henriksen) search for buried treasure on a cursed island.

title: Jack the Giant Killer
description: Jack climbs a beanstalk into clouds filled with evil beasts. When the beasts climb down the stalk, Jack has to figure out a way to get them back into the clouds before they destroy the Earth.

title: Zoombies
description: A mysterious virus turns animals at a safari park into bloodthirsty zombies.

title: Paranormal Entity
description: A paranormal investigator who was wrongfully imprisoned for murdering his sister finds footage of demons killing her.

title: 8213: Gacy House
description: Ghost hunters wire a serial killer's home with paranormal detection equipment and get terrifying and grisly results.

title: Heretics
description: Thrill-seeking teens break into an abandoned house only to encounter a dark cult that wants to sacrifice them one by one.

title: Shark Week
description: Trapped on a madman's (Patrick Bergin) island, a group of people must survive a barrage of shark attacks.

title: Frankenstein's Bride
description: When rioting villagers kill Frankenstein's monster, its bride leaves a trail of blood in its wake as it vows revenge against the townsfolk responsible.

title: Abraham Lincoln vs. Zombies
description: While the Civil War rages, President Abraham Lincoln undertakes an even tougher task -- destroying the Confederate walking dead.

title: Almighty Thor
description: After Loki (Richard Grieco) destroys Valhalla and steals the Hammer of Invincibility, only the young hero, Thor (Cody Deal), can protect Earth from Armageddon.

title: 100 Million BC
description: Disaster strikes when scientists travel back in time, then return to Los Angeles, inadvertently bringing a dinosaur with them.

title: Atlantic Rim: Resurrection
description: Humans pilot giant robots to defend Los Angeles from massive monsters that emerge from the ocean.

title: Mega Python vs. Gatoroid
description: Locals in the Florida Everglades have to find a way to kill giant pythons and alligators after they start eating people.

title: Mega Shark vs Crocosaurus
description: The United States Army is called in to destroy a megalodon and a crocosaurus after their battle causes massive destruction.

title: Z Nation
description:
S02 E09 — Rozwell
The team finds an abandoned Air Force base and discovers what looks like alien technology.

title: 2010: Moby Dick
description: The captain of a submarine embarks on an obsessive quest to kill a gigantic prehistoric whale.

title: King of the Lost World
description: Survivors of a plane crash in the Amazon encounter giant scorpions, dragons and a gorilla.

title: 200 mph
description: After his older brother's death, a young amateur racer plunges into the world of illegal street-racing to get revenge.

title: Halloween Night
description: A horribly burned man (Scot Nery) escapes from a mental institution and terrorizes teenagers at a party.

title: Z Nation
description:
No Mercy, Part 2
The gang protects the town against a new enemy.

title: Martian Land
description: In the future, mankind lives on Mars in cities protected by force fields. When a massive sandstorm destroys Mars New York, the city of Mars Los Angeles has to find a way to stop the storm before it wipes them out.

title: Battledogs
description: When a strange werewolf virus threatens to decimate first New York and then the world, a rogue general uses the disease to create an army of supersoldiers.

title: Nightmare Wedding
description: A woman (Nicola Posener) comes to regret a past indiscretion with her fiancé's best friend (Evan Henderson) when he becomes their best man.

title: Age of Dinosaurs
description: A former firefighter fights to rescue his teenage daughter after living dinosaurs escape from a museum exhibit.

title: Megalodon Rising
description: An armada of modern warships proves no match for a megalodon: a giant shark thought to be extinct.

title: Thor: God of Thunder
description: Thor's villainous Uncle Loki has escaped Asgard in search of Yggdrasil, the Tree of the Nine Realms.
